name: Greed is Good?
description: Draw 2 cards for your Draw Phase instead of 1, but, your hand-size limit is 0 for the end of turns (discard until you have 0 cards in your hand during the End Phase). Your hand size limit is increased by 1 for every 4 DEX you have.

name: Chicken
description: (Once per Duel) Pay 500 LP: Draw 1 card. Your opponent can then pay 1000 LP to draw 1 card. Continue passing this choice with the LP cost doubling until one player decides to stop.

name: Mulligan
description: At the start of the duel, you can shuffle your hand back into your Deck and draw a new starting hand. You can use this skill an additional time for every 2 CHA or INT you have (whichever is greater).

name: Parasitic Invasion
description: Add 3 "Parasite Paracide" to your Deck (permanently). At the start of the Duel, activate the Flip effects of all "Parasite Paracide" in your Deck and Hand. Draw cards to replace the ones activated in your hand so that your hand size is 5 again. If your opponent Special Summons a "Parasite Paracide", draw 1 card.

name: Scapelamba
description: Start the game with a Token in play ("Scapelamba" 2000 ATK/2000 DEF Level 4 Earth/Beast). Make an additional identical Token for each 3 CON you have.

name: Staff of Avarice
description: (Once per Duel) You can shuffle 1 card in your GY back into the Deck to draw 1 card. You can activate this an additional time per Duel for every 2 INT you have (but only once per turn).

name: Future Visions
description: (During your first Draw Phase): You can discard 1 card, activate 1 "Future Fusion" from your Deck. (Add "Future Fusion" to your inventory).

name: A Visit to the Old Sage
description: (Once per Duel): You can reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck, add 1 monster listed on it as a Fusion Material from your Deck or GY to your hand, then, you can add "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand (Add "Polymerization" to your inventory).

name: Ritual Tribute
description: You can conduct a Tribute Summon in addition to your Normal Summon/Set each turn.

name: Card Vendor
description: (During your first Standby Phase) (Once per Duel): You can activate up to 3 "Card Trader" from your Deck. You can activate the effect of "Card Trader" during your opponent\'s Standby Phase. (Add "Card Trader" to your inventory.)

name: Sacrifice to the Cards
description: (Once per Duel) (During your opponent’s turn) (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 monster you control and draw 2 cards. Your opponent can activate cards/effects in response to the activation of this skill. You can use this skill an additional time per Duel for every 3 STR you have.

name: Metalmorph
description: Take 300 damage less from any source of damage. The damage reduction is increased by 100 for every 2 STR you have.

name: Unexpected Die
description: (Once per Duel): Add 1 "Unexpected Dai" from your Deck to your hand. (Add "Unexpected Dai" and "Little D" to your inventory.)

name: Dark Emissary
description: Start the Duel with "Gorz the Emissary of Darkness" in your hand (if you drew "Gorz the Emissary of Darkness" in your opening hand, reveal it and draw a card instead of adding it to your hand). (Add "Gorz the Emissary of Darkness" to your inventory).

name: Normal Summon Alligator
description: When you Normal Summon "Alligator's Sword" you can add 1 "Kunai with Chain" from your Deck or GY to your hand, then draw 2 cards and discard 2 cards (Add "Alligator's Sword" and "Kunai with Chain" to your inventory).

name: Faulty Programming
description: Each player draws 2 cards for their Draw Phase, except during the first Draw Phase. Each player must shuffle 1 card they control or in their hand into the Deck during their End Phase, except during the first End Phase.

name: Chilly Shores
description: (Once per Duel): Next turn, the next 2 times you would take damage, or a monster you control would be destroyed by battle, you do not take damage and that monster is not destroyed. You can use this skill an additional time per Duel for every 4 CON you have.

name: Normal Seal
description: Non-effect monsters and monsters with negated effects on your side of the field gain 500 ATK/DEF while face-up on the field. (Once per Duel): You can negate the effects of a face-up monster you control, or, give a non-effect monster you control 500 ATK.

name: Tapped Potential
description: You can tribute 1 "Fiend Scorpion" to Special Summon 1 "Millennium Scorpion" from your hand or Deck, then you can add up to 2 Trap Card(s) from your Deck to your hand. "Millennium Scorpion" you control gain 1000 ATK for their effect instead of 500. (Add "Fiend Scorpion" and "Millennium Scorpion" to your inventory).

name: Archetype Madness
description: Declare 1 card name in your inventory and 1 archetype name. That card becomes part of that archetype. You can declare an additional card name and archetype name for every 2 Stats you have 5 or more points in.

name: Lifesteal
description: Lifesteal - If your monster battles an opponent's monster and inflicts damage to them, gain LP equal to the amount inflicted. Gain 200 LP more for every 2 STR you have.

name: The Tragedy
description: (Once per turn): If a monster you control is destroyed by battle you can add 1 "Tragoedia" from your Deck to your hand. You can add 1 additional “Tragoedia” for every 3 CON you have. (Add "Tragoedia" to your inventory.)

name: Legendary Sacrifice
description: (Once per turn): If your Legendary Monster is destroyed, draw 2 cards.

name: Mind Scan
description: (Once per turn): You can target 1 Set card your opponent controls; you can look at it or declare a card name, and if the card is the declared card destroy it. Cards and effects can be activated in response to this Skill. You can use this skill an additional time each turn if you have 3 or more INT.

name: Lucky Die
description: (Once per turn): Reveal 1 monster in your hand and roll a six-sided die. The level of that monster becomes that roll until the end of the turn. If the result is higher than 4, draw 1 card.

name: We are Number One
description: (Once per Duel): If you control a Normal monster, you can Special Summon up to 2 monsters from your Deck with the same name as that monster, also, monsters you control summoned from the Extra Deck this turn have their effects negated.

name: Tank-Up
description: (Once per Duel) (During your Main Phase 1): You can switch all monsters you control to Defense Position, then, they gain 1500 DEF. You can activate this skill during your Main Phase 2 if you have 4 or more CON. You can use this an additional time per Duel if you have 4 or more STR.

name: Strong Arm
description: (Once per Duel): You can make 1 monster your opponent controls declare an attack, or if it's in Defense Position, you can change it to Attack Position. Neither player takes battle damage this turn with battle involving that card. You choose the attack target if you have 5 or more STR.

name: Lawnmower
description: (Once per Duel): You can send the top card of your deck to the GY. Your opponent can then repeat this effect, but sends twice as many as the previous amount. Continue passing this choice with the number sent doubling until one player decides to stop.

name: Deck Hurty Virus
description: (Once per Duel) (before the start of the duel): Both players discard 5, mill 5, then draw 5. This does not trigger either player’s GY effects of any kind unless that player has 10 or more INT.

name: Rainbow Energy
description: (Once per Duel): You can declare an Attribute. For the rest of the Duel, all face-up monsters you control are also treated as that Attribute. For every Stat you have 2 or more points in, you can declare an additional Attribute.

name: Minigun
description: You start the Duel with 500 charges, and 500 more charges per every 3 STR you have. (Once per turn): You can spend any number of charges and lower the ATK 1 face-up monster by that much. If this reduces its ATK to 0, destroy the monster and gain 500 charges. (Once per turn) (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 monster you control to gain 500 charges.

name: Fusion Festival!
description: (Once per turn): If you Fusion Summon a monster, you can add 1 "Polymerization" and 1 monster used as Fusion Material for that monster from your GY to your hand (add "Polymerization" and "Garura, Wings of Resonant Life" to your inventory). If you're Toy Maker you can only use this Skill once per Duel.

name: Normie Gathering
description: (Once per Duel): You can add 1 non-effect monster from your Deck to your hand, except for your Legendary Monster(s). This effect is once per turn if you have 3 or more INT. (Once per Duel): You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower non-effect monster from your hand.

name: Wreck-less
description: (Once per Duel): You can discard 1 card; add 1 "Rush Recklessly" from your Deck to your hand. This effect is once per turn if you have 4 or more STR. (Once per Duel): If a monster you control destroys an opponent’s monster by battle: you can add 1 "Rush Recklessly" from your GY to your hand.

name: Storm Sceptre
description: (Once per Duel): If an opponent’s Spell/Trap card is sent to the GY during your turn: you can add 1 "Mystical Space Typhoon" from your Deck to your hand. This effect is once per turn if you have 4 or more DEX (add "Mystical Space Typhoon" to your inventory).

name: Cosmic Sceptre
description: (Once per Duel): If a card in your opponent’s possession is banished: add 1 "Cosmic Cyclone" from your Deck to your hand (add  "Cosmic Cyclone" to your inventory).

name: A Tribute to Those Who Lost
description: (Once per Duel): If a card in your opponent’s possession is destroyed by a card or Skill effect during your turn: add 1 "Tribute to the Doomed" from your Deck to your hand (add "Tribute to the Doomed" to your inventory).

name: Chainlonk
description: Once per Duel (Quick Effect): You can activate this Skill as only Chain Link 2 or higher: This current chain resolves forwards instead of backwards.

name: My Crazy New Link 1 Idea
description: (Once per Duel) If you Link Summon "Clara & Rushka, the Ventriloduo", you can add 1 Field Spell from your Deck to your hand. (Add "Clara & Rushka, the Ventriloduo" to your inventory)

name: Quest of Young Adult
description: (Once per turn): You can reveal 1 Level 5 or higher monster; this turn you can Normal Summon that monster without tributing. You can't reveal a monster with the same level of a previously revealed monster for the rest of the Duel.

name: Marvelous Meatball
description: The effect of "Nibiru, the Primal Being" is instead: "During the Main Phase, if your opponent Normal/Special Summoned 5 or more monsters this turn (Quick Effect): You can return 1 card your opponent controls to the hand, then Special Summon this card. You can return up to 2 cards with this effect if you have 5 or more STR." (Add "Nibiru, the Primal Being" to your inventory)

name: Social Distancing
description: (Once per turn): During your Draw Phase, draw 2 cards. Cards you control cannot be in adjacent zones (excluding Field Zone) to each other. For every Stat with 4 or more points you can have 2 adjacent cards.

name: Exodia, Obliterate! -
description: (Once per turn) (During your Draw Phase): Send 1 "Forbidden One" card from your hand or Deck to the GY. (Once per turn): If you have all 5 pieces of Exodia in your GY, you can target 1 monster on the field; destroy it. (Add 1 of each of the pieces of Exodia to your Deck, permanently).

name: My Wingman!
description: The effect of "Super Polymerization" is now: "Discard 1 card and send 1 monster from your Deck to your GY: Special Summon 1 "Flame Wingman" from your Extra Deck (this is treated as a Fusion Summon). (Once per turn): While you control "Flame Wingman", you can activate 1 "Skyscraper" from your Deck or GY, then Special Summon 1 "Ancient Gear Golem" from your Deck or GY to your opponent’s side of the field, ignoring its summoning conditions. (Add 3 "Super Polymerization", 3 "Flame Wingman" to your Deck, permanently. Add "Skyscraper" and "Ancient Gear GoleM" to your inventory.)

name: Utopic Goober
description: You can Xyz Summon "Number 39: Utopia" with monsters of any level (Add 3 "Number 39: Utopia" to your Extra Deck, permanently).

name: Talkers, Decoded
description: (Once per turn): You can tribute 1 card "Decode Talker" points to draw 1 card, or if the tributed monster was Link Summoned, draw cards equal to its Link Rating. (Add "Decode Talker" to your inventory.

name: Blazing Brazier -
description: (Once per turn) (During the End Phase): You can send the top card of your Deck to the GY. After each time you use this skill, this skill sends an additional card until the end of the Duel (max 3).

name: Torchlight
description: During your Draw Phase, instead of your normal draw, banish the top two cards of your Deck facedown, then add 1 from among those two facedown banished cards to your hand.

name: Advanced Worship
description: Add 1 of each of the Egyptian Gods to your Deck (permanently). You can Tribute Summon them for 2 Tributes instead of 3. Negate the fourth effect of "Slifer the Sky Dragon".

name: Magical Warrior’s Blessing
description: (Once per turn): If you Normal Summon "Breaker the Magical Warrior", you can Normal Summon another monster this turn. If you destroy a Spell/Trap with the effect of "Breaker the Magical Warrior", you can draw 1 card. (Add "Breaker the Magical Warrior" to your inventory.)

name: Dimension Rod
description: (Once per Duel) (During your Draw Phase): You can shuffle 3 of your cards that are banished into the Deck to draw 1 card.

name: Tuning Fork
description: (Once per Duel): Target 1 non-Tuner monster you control; it is treated as a Tuner. (Add "Stardust Dragon" to your inventory.)

name: Sacrificial Arts
description: You can Normal Summon an additional time each turn, but each time you Normal Summon, you must pay 1000 LP. You can still use this effect even if you cannot pay the LP cost.

name: Dedidated Crows
description: "D.D. Crow" can only target non-Legendary monsters (add "D.D. Crow" to your inventory).

name: Spell Overflow!
description: During your End Phase, gain 300 LP for each Spell card in your GY.

name: Thin Margins
description: (Once per turn): You can banish 1 card from your hand, and add 1 card with the same name from your Deck to your hand. You can add 2 cards instead if you have 6 or more DEX.

name: Destiny Draw
description: (Once per Duel): During your Draw Phase, if your LP are lower than 4000, you can give up your normal draw, and add 1 card from your Deck to your hand. You can use this ignoring the LP requirement if you have 7 or more CHA.

name: Monster Mash
description: If you control no Spell/Trap cards, you can use your Spell & Trap Zones as Monster Zones. If a Spell/Trap card is on your field, send all monsters in your Spell & Trap Zones to the GY.

name: Young Upstart
description: During your first Standby Phase, you can shuffle up to 3 cards from your hand into the Deck, and add the same number of "Upstart Goblin" from your Deck to your hand. If you have 2 or more INT, you can add 1 “Upstart Goblin” from your Deck to your hand during your first Draw Phase. (Add "Upstart Goblin" to your inventory.)

name: Exchange
description: Before the Match, you and your opponent choose 1 of the others Skills (except Exchange), and swap them for this match. If you have 6 or more CHA, you choose the Skill for your opponent.

name: Steep Gamble
description: (Once per Duel): You can draw 2 cards, and your opponent gains 8000 LP. If you have 8 or more CON, you also gain 8000 LP. If you have 8 or more DEX, you draw 2 more cards. If you have 8 or more INT, you can also shuffle any number of cards from your GY back into your Deck after you draw.

name: Doomed Tribute
description: (Once per Duel) - You can tribute 1 face-up monster you control and target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. Your opponent can activate cards/effects in response to this skill's activation. You can use this Skill an additional time per Duel for every 5 STR you have (but only once per turn).

name: Shard Hunter
description: (Once per Duel): You can discard 2 cards and activate up to 3 "Shard of Greed" from your Deck and/or GY. You can send "Shard of Greed" you control to the GY with 1 Greed Counter on it to draw 1 card. If you have 4 or more INT, place 1 Greed Counter on "Shard of Greed" when you activate it. (Add "Shard of Greed" to your inventory.)

name: Yūgō Shōkan
description: (Once per Duel): Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material. That monster cannot be targeted or destroyed by card effects this turn. This is treated as a card effect.

name: Laughing Tail
description: If your opponent declares an attack on a monster you control: You can send any number of cards from your hand to the GY; that monster gains 1000 ATK for each card sent until the end of the Damage Step. Neither player takes battle damage from this battle, also the attacking monster cannot be destroyed by this battle.

name: Mind Wash Car Wash
description: (Once per Duel): You can give 1 monster you control to your opponent; add 1 “Brain Control” from your Deck to your hand (add 1 “Brain Control” to your deck, permanently, or add 3 “Brain Control” to your inventory instead, if you have 4 or more INT).

name: I’m Something of an Artist Myself
description: (Once per turn) During the Draw Phase: You can skip your Normal Draw to add 1 “Drawbread” from your Deck to your hand. If you draw a “Drawbread” from the effect of “Drawbread”, draw a card and add 1 “Drawbread” from your GY to your hand. (Add “Drawbread” to your inventory).

name: Chang’e’s Favour
description: You can also use the effect of “Silhouhatte Rabbit” that activates when it’s Link Summoned as if it was an Ignition Effect during your Main Phase. While you control a Continuous Trap that is also treated as a monster, your opponent cannot attack any “Silhouhatte Rabbit” you control. Add “Silhouhatte Rabbit” and “Tiki Soul” to your inventory.

name: Growthy McGrowthface
description: (Once per Duel): You can place 1 “Growth” token on a monster you control (if that monster would ever be destroyed, remove 1 “Growth” token from it instead). Once per Duel, during your next Draw Phase: Tribute 1 monster with a “Growth” token on it; Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck.

name: Full Moon
description: Add “Book of Moon” to your inventory. “Book of Moon” is treated as a Normal Spell Card, and can only be used any time you could use a Spell Speed 1 Effect. (Once per turn): If either player controls a Set monster, you can add 1 “Book of Moon” from your Deck to your hand.

name: Read This, My Rival
description: You and your current opponent can both add 1 "S:P Little Knight" to your respective Extra Decks for this Round. (Once per Duel): You can add 1 "S:P Little Knight" from your GY/banishment to your Extra Deck and draw 1 card. Your opponent can show 1 "S:P Little Knight" in their possession to negate this effect.

name: Buzz Buzz, My Rival
description: You and your current opponent can both add 3 “K9-17 Izuna”, 1 “K9-ØØ Lupis” and up to 3 (min 1) “Drill Driver Vespenato” to your respective Main/Extra Decks. (Once per Duel): You can add up to 3 “Drill Driver Vespenato” from your GY/banishment to your Extra Deck and draw 1 card. Your opponent can show 1 “K9-17 Izuna” in their possession to negate this effect.

name: Bigly Questing
description: Win a Match without dropping below 6000 LP. Rewards - Gold: 5

name: Mythical Mishaps
description: Win a Match without any Class Loot. Rewards - Class: paladin
